reason: Preserve existing canonical record statuses and incoming room/mention/reply semantics while replacing the public DTO boundary. These definitions are unreleased.
changes: Messaging record status enums retain sending, delivered, and read.
Chat MessageReceived has safe conversation kind/name, portable mention details, and one-level reply context.
No raw provider map, credentials, recursive reply, runtime authority, or private client field is added.
Paged requests retain the forward/backward direction field. OpenThread retains a safe topic_name field.
Runtime MarkAsRead retains a safe read_at string. message_id is canonical; the trusted principal supplies the reader. Provider confirmation precedes receipt persistence.

Runtime SendMessage without bridge_id uses the owned routing policy. All selected routes require grants before calls. Closed route summaries retain successful and failed route counts. No new generic event type or callback data is added.
Native tool results use finite operation variants and closed data shapes in the registered runtime result definitions. Private control results expose only identity/activity facts.
MessageFailed includes observation_failed and uses schema-matching failure codes. Private telemetry keeps canonical records; those records are absent from public Signal data.
remaining: Update provider mappers and all conformance evidence against this final schema.
